# Student 4 Release 2 Testing Evidence

## Scope

Student 4 Skill Profile Service adds profile-grounded Multi-Agent
review through the shared server, with frontend and backend proxy
routes and a Student 4 evidence adapter.

## Automated endpoint tests

Four local tests passed for two distinct backend endpoint functions:
api_create_profile and api_get_profile.

Cases:
- Successful creation forwards the supplied payload and returns 201.
- Empty creation data returns 400 without calling the database.
- Successful retrieval forwards the profile ID and returns its data.
- Missing-profile retrieval preserves the database service's 404.

These are Flask endpoint tests with mocked database calls. They do
not prove live database persistence or external AI availability.

Test source: student-4/backend/tests/test_endpoints.py
Recorded output: reports/release2/evidence/student-4-endpoint-tests.txt

## Security checks

The staged changes passed the configured Ruff security/correctness,
detect-secrets, and pip-audit hooks.

Configuration: .pre-commit-config.yaml
Recorded output: reports/release2/evidence/student-4-security-checks.txt

These results apply to the scope selected by the configured hooks.

## Manual Multi-Agent checks

Verified:
- Backend connectivity to the shared server.
- Retrieval of profile 1 as workflow evidence.
- Successful Worker output using llama3.1:8b.
- Successful Reviewer output.
- Frontend approval publishes the accepted answer.
- Frontend correction publishes the replacement text.
- Terminal rejection returns rejected with no final response.

The initial qwen2.5:0.5b Worker returned an invalid limitations field.
Switching the Worker to llama3.1:8b produced valid output in the
subsequent observed run. Model output remains nondeterministic.

## Agentic review

The Student 4 multi-agent-review scenario passed on its first attempt:
executed 1, passed 1, failed 0, skipped 0.

Audit: ai-services/agentic-loop/evidence/agentic-validation.jsonl
Original workflows: ai-services/multi-agent-server/runtime/workflows

## CI and remaining limits

The Student 4 CI workflow includes the four endpoint tests.
Remote CI execution has not yet been verified for these changes.

Partial acceptance, full R1 regression checks, final integration,
and Student 4 cloud CRUD verification remain outstanding.

repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
    rev: v0.17.1
    hooks:
      - id: ruff-check
        name: Ruff security and correctness
        args:
          - --select=S,F
          - --output-format=concise
        files: ^(ai-services/|student-[1-5]/|scripts/)

  - repo: https://github.com/Yelp/detect-secrets
    rev: v1.5.0
    hooks:
      - id: detect-secrets
        name: Detect committed secrets

  - repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: pip-audit-release2
        name: pip-audit Release 2 dependencies
        entry: python scripts/security/pip_audit_release2.py
        language: python
        additional_dependencies:
          - pip-audit==2.10.1
        always_run: true
        require_serial: true

name: Student 4 - Skill Profile CI

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - "student-4/**"
      - "ai-services/mcp-server/tools/student4.py"
      - "ai-services/rag-server/sources/student4.py"
      - "ai-services/agentic-loop/scenarios/student4.py"
      - ".github/workflows/student-4-ci.yml"
      - "ai-services/multi-agent-server/**"

  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "student-4/**"
      - "ai-services/mcp-server/tools/student4.py"
      - "ai-services/rag-server/sources/student4.py"
      - "ai-services/agentic-loop/scenarios/student4.py"
      - ".github/workflows/student-4-ci.yml"

  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4


      # =========================
      # BUILD STUDENT 4 SERVICES
      # =========================

      - name: Build database image
        run: |
          docker build \
            -t student4-database \
            ./student-4/database


      - name: Build backend image
        run: |
          docker build \
            -t student4-backend \
            ./student-4/backend


      - name: Test Student 4 backend endpoints
        run: |
          docker run --rm student4-backend \
            python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

      - name: Build frontend image
        run: |
          docker build \
            -t student4-frontend \
            ./student-4/frontend


      # =========================
      # CREATE TEST NETWORK
      # =========================

      - name: Create Docker network
        run: |
          docker network create student4-network


      # =========================
      # START DATABASE
      # =========================

      - name: Start database service
        run: |
          docker run -d \
            --name student4-database \
            --network student4-network \
            -p 5004:5004 \
            student4-database


      - name: Check database health
        run: |
          for i in {1..10}; do
            if curl --fail http://localhost:5004/; then
              exit 0
            fi

            echo "Waiting for database..."
            sleep 2
          done

          exit 1


      # =========================
      # START BACKEND
      # =========================

      - name: Start backend service
        run: |
          docker run -d \
            --name student4-backend \
            --network student4-network \
            -p 5005:5005 \
            -e DATABASE_SERVICE_URL="http://student4-database:5004" \
            -e MCP_ENABLED="false" \
            -e RAG_ENABLED="false" \
            student4-backend


      - name: Check backend health
        run: |
          for i in {1..10}; do
            if curl --fail http://localhost:5005/; then
              exit 0
            fi

            echo "Waiting for backend..."
            sleep 2
          done

          exit 1


      # =========================
      # VALIDATE SEED DATA / API
      # =========================

      - name: Validate Skill Profile API
        run: |
          curl --fail \
            http://localhost:5005/api/profiles/student/4


      - name: Validate seeded profile
        run: |
          curl --fail \
            http://localhost:5005/api/profiles/student/10


      # =========================
      # START FRONTEND
      # =========================

      - name: Start frontend service
        run: |
          docker run -d \
            --name student4-frontend \
            --network student4-network \
            -p 5006:5006 \
            -e BACKEND_SERVICE_URL="http://student4-backend:5005" \
            student4-frontend


      - name: Check frontend
        run: |
          for i in {1..10}; do
            if curl --fail http://localhost:5006/; then
              exit 0
            fi

            echo "Waiting for frontend..."
            sleep 2
          done

          exit 1


      # =========================
      # DEBUGGING EVIDENCE
      # =========================

      - name: Show running containers
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker ps -a


      - name: Show database logs
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker logs student4-database || true


      - name: Show backend logs
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker logs student4-backend || true


      - name: Show frontend logs
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker logs student4-frontend || true

# Release 2 Cloud Deployment Report

## Deployment Summary

The Release 2 integrated University Management Platform was successfully deployed to Microsoft Azure from the official Group 22 repository.

- Repository: `ASD-Group-22/ASD-Project`
- Branch: `release2/cloud-deployment`
- Commit: `f18c9175457e54423db1214b37e9a57e433c63fa`
- GitHub Actions run: `39589826282`
- Image tag: `release2-f18c917`
- Resource group: `lab11-rg`
- Container Apps environment: `lab11-env-31080-standard`
- Azure Container Registry: `lab11registry3098`
- Deployment result: **PASS**

## Architecture

The cloud deployment contains 16 Group 22 Release 2 Azure Container Apps:

- 1 shared home application
- 5 student frontend applications
- 5 student backend/API applications
- 5 student database applications

The shared home and the five student frontend applications use external ingress.

Student backend and database Container Apps use internal ingress so they are not exposed directly to the public internet.

Frontend applications communicate with their corresponding backend services through cloud-compatible proxy routing. Backends communicate with database services using their internal Azure Container Apps FQDNs.

Student 2 and Student 3 also communicate with the Student 4 Skill Profile backend using its internal Azure FQDN.

## Release 2 Cloud Baseline

The local Release 2 AI services are intentionally disabled in the cloud baseline.

Student 1:
- `AI_ENABLED=false`
- `MCP_ENABLED=false`
- `RAG_ENABLED=false`

Student 2:
- `AI_ENABLED=false`
- `ENABLE_REVIEW_MODEL=false`
- `MCP_ENABLED=false`
- `RAG_ENABLED=false`
- `MULTI_AGENT_ENABLED=false`

Student 3:
- `AI_ENABLED=false`
- `MCP_ENABLED=false`
- `RAG_ENABLED=false`

Student 4:
- `AI_ENABLED=false`
- `MCP_ENABLED=false`
- `RAG_ENABLED=false`
- `FLASK_DEBUG=false`

Student 5:
- `AI_MODE=false`
- `MCP_MODE=false`
- `RAG_MODE=false`

MCP, RAG, Multi-Agent and the local agentic services are therefore not required as Azure Container Apps for the baseline cloud deployment.

## CI and Security Validation

The deployment workflow required successful Student 1 through Student 5 CI runs for the exact deployment commit before Azure deployment could begin.

For commit `f18c9175457e54423db1214b37e9a57e433c63fa`:

- Student 1 CI: PASS
- Student 2 CI: PASS
- Student 3 CI: PASS
- Student 4 CI: PASS
- Student 5 CI: PASS
- Release 2 integration CI: PASS

Before the cloud implementation was committed, the repository security checks also passed:

- Ruff security and correctness: PASS
- detect-secrets: PASS
- pip-audit Release 2 dependencies: PASS

Student 4 dependency versions were updated to remove vulnerabilities identified by pip-audit.

## Azure Authentication

GitHub Actions authenticates to Azure using OpenID Connect rather than a stored Azure client secret.

The official Group 22 repository and `release2/cloud-deployment` branch were added as a federated credential on the existing `g22-r2-github-oidc` managed identity.

The deployment identity has Contributor access to the existing Release 2 Azure resource group.

The deployed Container Apps use the existing `g22-r2-acr-pull` managed identity for Azure Container Registry access.

## Deployment Validation

The official deployment workflow successfully:

1. validated the five required student CI workflows,
2. authenticated to Azure using GitHub OIDC,
3. verified the existing Azure resource group, registry, Container Apps environment and managed identity,
4. built all 16 Release 2 container images,
5. pushed the images to Azure Container Registry,
6. deployed five database Container Apps,
7. deployed five backend Container Apps,
8. deployed five frontend Container Apps,
9. deployed the shared home Container App,
10. executed integrated Azure deployment and CRUD validation.

The validation confirmed:

- all 16 Group 22 Release 2 Container Apps were provisioned successfully,
- the shared home returned HTML,
- the shared home linked to all five Azure student frontends,
- Student 1 CRUD passed,
- Student 2 CRUD passed, including soft-delete validation,
- Student 3 CRUD passed,
- Student 4 CRUD passed,
- Student 5 CRUD passed.

All feature validation requests were made through the externally exposed frontend applications while backend and database applications remained internal.

## Shared Home

The deployed shared home application is:

`https://g22-r2-home.gentlemushroom-26567496.australiaeast.azurecontainerapps.io`

## Limitations

Azure Container Apps scale-to-zero may cause a cold-start delay. The deployment validation includes retry behaviour for this condition.

The current Release 2 cloud baseline focuses on the integrated feature application with AI, MCP, RAG and Multi-Agent functionality disabled as required for the cloud baseline.

The deployment reuses the existing Azure infrastructure rather than creating a duplicate resource group, Container Apps environment or registry.

## Evidence

The detailed deployment evidence is stored in:

`reports/release2/cloud-deployment-results.md`

Official GitHub Actions deployment:

`https://github.com/ASD-Group-22/ASD-Project/actions/runs/39589826282`

supplemental_artifacts.content:
name: Release 2 - Integrated Azure Deployment

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: release2-azure-deployment
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  RESOURCE_GROUP: lab11-rg
  ACA_ENV: lab11-env-31080-standard
  ACR_NAME: lab11registry3098
  IDENTITY_NAME: g22-r2-acr-pull

jobs:
  validate-student-ci:
    name: Validate required student CI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Require successful student workflows for this commit
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          echo "Validating student CI for commit: $GITHUB_SHA"
          echo

          workflows=(
            "student-1-ci.yml"
            "student-2-ci.yml"
            "student-3-ci.yml"
            "student-4-ci.yml"
            "student-5-ci.yml"
          )

          for workflow in "${workflows[@]}"; do
            echo "Checking $workflow..."

            result="$(
              gh run list \
                --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
                --workflow "$workflow" \
                --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" \
                --limit 20 \
                --json headSha,conclusion,url
            )"

            success_url="$(
              printf '%s' "$result" |
                jq -r \
                  --arg sha "$GITHUB_SHA" \
                  '[.[] | select(.headSha == $sha and .conclusion == "success")][0].url // empty'
            )"

            if [[ -z "$success_url" ]]; then
              echo "::error::No successful $workflow run exists for commit $GITHUB_SHA."
              echo "Run or wait for the required student CI workflows, then rerun this deployment."
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "PASS: $workflow"
            echo "      $success_url"
            echo
          done

          echo "All five required student CI workflows passed for $GITHUB_SHA."

  deploy-azure:
    name: Deploy integrated application to Azure
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: validate-student-ci

    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact validated commit
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set deployment image tag
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "DEPLOY_TAG=release2-${GITHUB_SHA::7}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Azure login using GitHub OIDC
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Prepare Azure CLI
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          az config set extension.use_dynamic_install=yes_without_prompt
          az extension add --name containerapp --upgrade --only-show-errors

      - name: Verify existing Azure deployment foundation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          az group show \
            --name "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --output none

          az acr show \
            --name "$ACR_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --output none

          az containerapp env show \
            --name "$ACA_ENV" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --output none

          az identity show \
            --name "$IDENTITY_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --output none

          echo "Azure deployment foundation: PASS"

      - name: Build all 16 Release 2 images
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IMAGE_TAG="release2-local" \
            bash scripts/cloud/azure/build-images.sh

      - name: Refresh Azure OIDC login before registry push
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Push all 16 images to Azure Container Registry
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ACR_NAME="$ACR_NAME" \
          IMAGE_TAG="release2-local" \
          REMOTE_TAG="$DEPLOY_TAG" \
            bash scripts/cloud/azure/push-images.sh

      - name: Refresh Azure OIDC login before deployment
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Deploy database Container Apps
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IMAGE_TAG="$DEPLOY_TAG" \
            bash scripts/cloud/azure/deploy-databases.sh

      - name: Deploy backend Container Apps
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IMAGE_TAG="$DEPLOY_TAG" \
            bash scripts/cloud/azure/deploy-backends.sh

      - name: Deploy frontend Container Apps
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IMAGE_TAG="$DEPLOY_TAG" \
            bash scripts/cloud/azure/deploy-frontends.sh

      - name: Deploy shared home Container App
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IMAGE_TAG="$DEPLOY_TAG" \
            bash scripts/cloud/azure/deploy-home.sh

      - name: Clear previous deployment evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          rm -f reports/release2/cloud-deployment-results.md

      - name: Validate integrated Azure deployment and CRUD
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          ./scripts/cloud/azure/deployment-testing.ps1

      - name: Record workflow deployment metadata
        if: success()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          {
            echo
            echo "## GitHub Actions Deployment"
            echo
            echo "- Workflow run: $GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
            echo "- Commit: $GITHUB_SHA"
            echo "- Image tag: $DEPLOY_TAG"
            echo "- Resource group: $RESOURCE_GROUP"
            echo "- Container Apps environment: $ACA_ENV"
            echo "- Registry: $ACR_NAME"
          } >> reports/release2/cloud-deployment-results.md

      - name: Upload cloud deployment evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release2-cloud-deployment-evidence-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: reports/release2/cloud-deployment-results.md
          if-no-files-found: warn

- pip-audit Release 2 dependencies: PASS

Student 4 dependency versions were updated to remove vulnerabilities identified by pip-audit.

## Azure Authentication

GitHub Actions authenticates to Azure using OpenID Connect rather than a stored Azure client secret.

The official Group 22 repository and `release2/cloud-deployment` branch were added as a federated credential on the existing `g22-r2-github-oidc` managed identity.

The deployment identity has Contributor access to the existing Release 2 Azure resource group.

The deployed Container Apps use the existing `g22-r2-acr-pull` managed identity for Azure Container Registry access.

## Deployment Validation

The official deployment workflow successfully:

1. validated the five required student CI workflows,
2. authenticated to Azure using GitHub OIDC,
3. verified the existing Azure resource group, registry, Container Apps environment and managed identity,
4. built all 16 Release 2 container images,
5. pushed the images to Azure Container Registry,
6. deployed five database Container Apps,
7. deployed five backend Container Apps,
8. deployed five frontend Container Apps,
9. deployed the shared home Container App,
10. executed integrated Azure deployment and CRUD validation.

The validation confirmed:

- all 16 Group 22 Release 2 Container Apps were provisioned successfully,
- the shared home returned HTML,
- the shared home linked to all five Azure student frontends,
- Student 1 CRUD passed,
- Student 2 CRUD passed, including soft-delete validation,
- Student 3 CRUD passed,
- Student 4 CRUD passed,
- Student 5 CRUD passed.

All feature validation requests were made through the externally exposed frontend applications while backend and database applications remained internal.

## Shared Home

The deployed shared home application is:

`https://g22-r2-home.gentlemushroom-26567496.australiaeast.azurecontainerapps.io`

## Limitations

Azure Container Apps scale-to-zero may cause a cold-start delay. The deployment validation includes retry behaviour for this condition.

The current Release 2 cloud baseline focuses on the integrated feature application with AI, MCP, RAG and Multi-Agent functionality disabled as required for the cloud baseline.

The deployment reuses the existing Azure infrastructure rather than creating a duplicate resource group, Container Apps environment or registry.

name: Release 2 - Integrated Azure Deployment

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: release2-azure-deployment
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  RESOURCE_GROUP: lab11-rg
  ACA_ENV: lab11-env-31080-standard
  ACR_NAME: lab11registry3098
  IDENTITY_NAME: g22-r2-acr-pull

jobs:
  validate-student-ci:
    name: Validate required student CI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Require successful student workflows for this commit
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          echo "Validating student CI for commit: $GITHUB_SHA"
          echo

          workflows=(
            "student-1-ci.yml"
            "student-2-ci.yml"
            "student-3-ci.yml"
            "student-4-ci.yml"
            "student-5-ci.yml"
          )

          for workflow in "${workflows[@]}"; do
            echo "Checking $workflow..."

            result="$(
              gh run list \
                --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
                --workflow "$workflow" \
                --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" \
                --limit 20 \
                --json headSha,conclusion,url
            )"

            success_url="$(
              printf '%s' "$result" |
                jq -r \
                  --arg sha "$GITHUB_SHA" \
                  '[.[] | select(.headSha == $sha and .conclusion == "success")][0].url // empty'
            )"

            if [[ -z "$success_url" ]]; then
              echo "::error::No successful $workflow run exists for commit $GITHUB_SHA."
              echo "Run or wait for the required student CI workflows, then rerun this deployment."
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "PASS: $workflow"
            echo "      $success_url"
            echo
          done

          echo "All five required student CI workflows passed for $GITHUB_SHA."

  deploy-azure:
    name: Deploy integrated application to Azure
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: validate-student-ci

    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact validated commit
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set deployment image tag
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "DEPLOY_TAG=release2-${GITHUB_SHA::7}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Azure login using GitHub OIDC
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Prepare Azure CLI
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          az config set extension.use_dynamic_install=yes_without_prompt
          az extension add --name containerapp --upgrade --only-show-errors

      - name: Verify existing Azure deployment foundation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          az group show \
            --name "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --output none

          az acr show \
            --name "$ACR_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --output none

          az containerapp env show \
            --name "$ACA_ENV" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --output none

          az identity show \
            --name "$IDENTITY_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --output none

          echo "Azure deployment foundation: PASS"

      - name: Build all 16 Release 2 images
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IMAGE_TAG="release2-local" \
            bash scripts/cloud/azure/build-images.sh

      - name: Refresh Azure OIDC login before registry push
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Push all 16 images to Azure Container Registry
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ACR_NAME="$ACR_NAME" \
          IMAGE_TAG="release2-local" \
          REMOTE_TAG="$DEPLOY_TAG" \
            bash scripts/cloud/azure/push-images.sh

      - name: Refresh Azure OIDC login before deployment
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Deploy database Container Apps
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IMAGE_TAG="$DEPLOY_TAG" \
            bash scripts/cloud/azure/deploy-databases.sh

      - name: Deploy backend Container Apps
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IMAGE_TAG="$DEPLOY_TAG" \
            bash scripts/cloud/azure/deploy-backends.sh

      - name: Deploy frontend Container Apps
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IMAGE_TAG="$DEPLOY_TAG" \
            bash scripts/cloud/azure/deploy-frontends.sh

      - name: Deploy shared home Container App
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IMAGE_TAG="$DEPLOY_TAG" \
            bash scripts/cloud/azure/deploy-home.sh

      - name: Clear previous deployment evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          rm -f reports/release2/cloud-deployment-results.md

      - name: Validate integrated Azure deployment and CRUD
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          ./scripts/cloud/azure/deployment-testing.ps1

      - name: Record workflow deployment metadata
        if: success()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          {
            echo
            echo "## GitHub Actions Deployment"
            echo
            echo "- Workflow run: $GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
            echo "- Commit: $GITHUB_SHA"
            echo "- Image tag: $DEPLOY_TAG"
            echo "- Resource group: $RESOURCE_GROUP"
            echo "- Container Apps environment: $ACA_ENV"
            echo "- Registry: $ACR_NAME"
          } >> reports/release2/cloud-deployment-results.md

      - name: Upload cloud deployment evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release2-cloud-deployment-evidence-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: reports/release2/cloud-deployment-results.md
          if-no-files-found: warn

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

RESOURCE_GROUP="${RESOURCE_GROUP:-lab11-rg}"
ACA_ENV="${ACA_ENV:-lab11-env-31080-standard}"
ACR_NAME="${ACR_NAME:-lab11registry3098}"
IDENTITY_NAME="${IDENTITY_NAME:-g22-r2-acr-pull}"
IMAGE_TAG="${IMAGE_TAG:-release2}"

echo "============================================================"
echo "Group 22 Release 2 backend deployment"
echo "============================================================"
echo "Resource group: $RESOURCE_GROUP"
echo "Environment:    $ACA_ENV"
echo "ACR:            $ACR_NAME"
echo "Image tag:      $IMAGE_TAG"
echo

LOGIN_SERVER="$(az acr show \
    --name "$ACR_NAME" \
    --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
    --query loginServer \
    --output tsv)"

IDENTITY_ID="$(az identity show \
    --name "$IDENTITY_NAME" \
    --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
    --query id \
    --output tsv)"

if [[ -z "$LOGIN_SERVER" || -z "$IDENTITY_ID" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Could not resolve ACR or managed identity." >&2
    exit 1
fi

az containerapp env show \
    --name "$ACA_ENV" \
    --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
    --output none

get_fqdn() {
    local app_name="$1"

    az containerapp show \
        --name "$app_name" \
        --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
        --query properties.configuration.ingress.fqdn \
        --output tsv
}

deploy_backend() {
    local app_name="$1"
    local repository="$2"
    local target_port="$3"
    shift 3

    local image="${LOGIN_SERVER}/${repository}:${IMAGE_TAG}"

    echo
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "Backend app: $app_name"
    echo "Image:       $image"
    echo "Target port: $target_port"
    echo "============================================================"

    if az containerapp show \
        --name "$app_name" \
        --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
        --output none \
        2>/dev/null; then

        echo "Existing Container App found. Updating..."

        az containerapp update \
            --name "$app_name" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --image "$image" \
            --set-env-vars "$@" \
            --min-replicas 0 \
            --max-replicas 1 \
            --only-show-errors \
            --output none

        az containerapp ingress enable \
            --name "$app_name" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --type internal \
            --target-port "$target_port" \
            --transport auto \
            --only-show-errors \
            --output none
    else
        echo "Creating Container App..."

        MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 az containerapp create \
            --name "$app_name" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --environment "$ACA_ENV" \
            --image "$image" \
            --user-assigned "$IDENTITY_ID" \
            --registry-server "$LOGIN_SERVER" \
            --registry-identity "$IDENTITY_ID" \
            --ingress internal \
            --target-port "$target_port" \
            --transport auto \
            --env-vars "$@" \
            --min-replicas 0 \
            --max-replicas 1 \
            --only-show-errors \
            --output none
    fi

    local fqdn
    fqdn="$(get_fqdn "$app_name")"

    echo "Ready: $app_name"
    echo "Internal FQDN: $fqdn"
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Resolve database service URLs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

S1_DB_FQDN="$(get_fqdn "g22-r2-s1-db")"
S2_DB_FQDN="$(get_fqdn "g22-r2-s2-db")"
S3_DB_FQDN="$(get_fqdn "g22-r2-s3-db")"
S4_DB_FQDN="$(get_fqdn "g22-r2-s4-db")"
S5_DB_FQDN="$(get_fqdn "g22-r2-s5-db")"

echo "Database FQDN resolution: PASS"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Student 4 first - S2 and S3 depend on Skill Profile
# ------------------------------------------------------------

deploy_backend \
    "g22-r2-s4-api" \
    "student4-backend" \
    "5005" \

    "AI_ENABLED=false" \
    "MCP_ENABLED=false" \
    "RAG_ENABLED=false" \
    "FLASK_DEBUG=false"

S4_API_FQDN="$(get_fqdn "g22-r2-s4-api")"

if [[ -z "$S4_API_FQDN" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Student 4 backend FQDN could not be resolved." >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo
echo "Student 4 dependency available:"
echo "https://${S4_API_FQDN}"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Student 1 - Project Management
# ------------------------------------------------------------

deploy_backend \
    "g22-r2-s1-api" \
    "student1-backend" \
    "5001" \
    "DATABASE_SERVICE_URL=https://${S1_DB_FQDN}" \
    "AI_ENABLED=false" \
    "MCP_ENABLED=false" \
    "RAG_ENABLED=false"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Student 2 - Skill Exchange
# ------------------------------------------------------------

    "g22-r2-s2-api" \
    "student2-backend" \
    "5001" \
    "DATABASE_SERVICE_URL=https://${S2_DB_FQDN}" \
    "SKILL_PROFILE_SERVICE_URL=https://${S4_API_FQDN}" \
    "AI_ENABLED=false" \
    "ENABLE_REVIEW_MODEL=false" \
    "MCP_ENABLED=false" \
    "RAG_ENABLED=false" \
    "MULTI_AGENT_ENABLED=false"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Student 3 - Project Group Formation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

deploy_backend \
    "g22-r2-s3-api" \
    "student3-backend" \
    "5000" \
    "DB_URL=https://${S3_DB_FQDN}" \
    "SKILL_PROFILE_SERVICE_URL=https://${S4_API_FQDN}" \
    "PROMPT_ROOT=/prompts" \
    "AI_ENABLED=false" \
    "MCP_ENABLED=false" \
    "RAG_ENABLED=false"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Student 5 - AI Campus Space Finder
# ------------------------------------------------------------

deploy_backend \
    "g22-r2-s5-api" \
    "student5-backend" \
    "8055" \
    "DATABASE_SERVICE_URL=https://${S5_DB_FQDN}" \
    "AI_MODE=false" \
    "MCP_MODE=false" \
    "RAG_MODE=false"

echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "All five Group 22 backend apps deployed successfully."
echo "AI / MCP / RAG / Multi-Agent cloud baseline: disabled"
echo "Scale: min 0 / max 1"
echo "Ingress: internal"
echo "============================================================"

# Student 4 Release 2 Testing Evidence

## Scope

Student 4 Skill Profile Service adds profile-grounded Multi-Agent
review through the shared server, with frontend and backend proxy
routes and a Student 4 evidence adapter.

## Automated endpoint tests

Four local tests passed for two distinct backend endpoint functions:
api_create_profile and api_get_profile.

Cases:
- Successful creation forwards the supplied payload and returns 201.
- Empty creation data returns 400 without calling the database.
- Successful retrieval forwards the profile ID and returns its data.
- Missing-profile retrieval preserves the database service's 404.

These are Flask endpoint tests with mocked database calls. They do
not prove live database persistence or external AI availability.

Test source: student-4/backend/tests/test_endpoints.py
Recorded output: reports/release2/evidence/student-4-endpoint-tests.txt

## Security checks

The staged changes passed the configured Ruff security/correctness,
detect-secrets, and pip-audit hooks.

Configuration: .pre-commit-config.yaml
Recorded output: reports/release2/evidence/student-4-security-checks.txt

These results apply to the scope selected by the configured hooks.

## Manual Multi-Agent checks

Verified:
- Backend connectivity to the shared server.
- Retrieval of profile 1 as workflow evidence.
- Successful Worker output using llama3.1:8b.
- Successful Reviewer output.
- Frontend approval publishes the accepted answer.
- Frontend correction publishes the replacement text.
- Terminal rejection returns rejected with no final response.

The initial qwen2.5:0.5b Worker returned an invalid limitations field.
Switching the Worker to llama3.1:8b produced valid output in the
subsequent observed run. Model output remains nondeterministic.

## Agentic review

The Student 4 multi-agent-review scenario passed on its first attempt:
executed 1, passed 1, failed 0, skipped 0.

Audit: ai-services/agentic-loop/evidence/agentic-validation.jsonl
Original workflows: ai-services/multi-agent-server/runtime/workflows

## CI and remaining limits

The Student 4 CI workflow includes the four endpoint tests.
Remote CI execution has not yet been verified for these changes.

Partial acceptance, full R1 regression checks, final integration,
and Student 4 cloud CRUD verification remain outstanding.

name: Student 4 - Skill Profile CI

on:
  push:

permissions:

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4


      # =========================
      # BUILD STUDENT 4 SERVICES
      # =========================

      - name: Build database image
        run: |
          docker build \
            -t student4-database \
            ./student-4/database


      - name: Build backend image
        run: |
          docker build \
            -t student4-backend \
            ./student-4/backend


      - name: Test Student 4 backend endpoints
        run: |
          docker run --rm student4-backend \
            python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

      - name: Build frontend image
        run: |
          docker build \
            -t student4-frontend \
            ./student-4/frontend


      # =========================
      # CREATE TEST NETWORK
      # =========================

      - name: Create Docker network
        run: |
          docker network create student4-network


      # =========================
      # START DATABASE
      # =========================

      - name: Start database service
        run: |
          docker run -d \
            --name student4-database \
            --network student4-network \
            -p 5004:5004 \
            student4-database


      - name: Check database health
        run: |
          for i in {1..10}; do
            if curl --fail http://localhost:5004/; then
              exit 0
            fi

            echo "Waiting for database..."
            sleep 2
          done

          exit 1


      # =========================
      # START BACKEND
      # =========================

      - name: Start backend service
        run: |
          docker run -d \
            --name student4-backend \
            --network student4-network \
            -p 5005:5005 \
            -e DATABASE_SERVICE_URL="http://student4-database:5004" \
            -e MCP_ENABLED="false" \
            -e RAG_ENABLED="false" \
            student4-backend


      - name: Check backend health
        run: |
          for i in {1..10}; do
            if curl --fail http://localhost:5005/; then
              exit 0

evidence.report:
# Student 4 Release 2 Testing Evidence

## Scope

Student 4 Skill Profile Service adds profile-grounded Multi-Agent
review through the shared server, with frontend and backend proxy
routes and a Student 4 evidence adapter.

## Automated endpoint tests

Four local tests passed for two distinct backend endpoint functions:
api_create_profile and api_get_profile.

Cases:
- Successful creation forwards the supplied payload and returns 201.
- Empty creation data returns 400 without calling the database.
- Successful retrieval forwards the profile ID and returns its data.
- Missing-profile retrieval preserves the database service's 404.

These are Flask endpoint tests with mocked database calls. They do
not prove live database persistence or external AI availability.

Test source: student-4/backend/tests/test_endpoints.py
Recorded output: reports/release2/evidence/student-4-endpoint-tests.txt

## Security checks

The staged changes passed the configured Ruff security/correctness,
detect-secrets, and pip-audit hooks.

Configuration: .pre-commit-config.yaml
Recorded output: reports/release2/evidence/student-4-security-checks.txt

These results apply to the scope selected by the configured hooks.

## Manual Multi-Agent checks

Verified:
- Backend connectivity to the shared server.
- Retrieval of profile 1 as workflow evidence.
- Successful Worker output using llama3.1:8b.
- Successful Reviewer output.
- Frontend approval publishes the accepted answer.
- Frontend correction publishes the replacement text.
- Terminal rejection returns rejected with no final response.

The initial qwen2.5:0.5b Worker returned an invalid limitations field.
Switching the Worker to llama3.1:8b produced valid output in the
subsequent observed run. Model output remains nondeterministic.

## Agentic review

The Student 4 multi-agent-review scenario passed on its first attempt:
executed 1, passed 1, failed 0, skipped 0.

Audit: ai-services/agentic-loop/evidence/agentic-validation.jsonl
Original workflows: ai-services/multi-agent-server/runtime/workflows

## CI and remaining limits

The Student 4 CI workflow includes the four endpoint tests.
Remote CI execution has not yet been verified for these changes.

Partial acceptance, full R1 regression checks, final integration,
and Student 4 cloud CRUD verification remain outstanding.

supplemental_artifacts.content:
repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
    rev: v0.17.1
    hooks:
      - id: ruff-check
        name: Ruff security and correctness
        args:
          - --select=S,F
          - --output-format=concise
        files: ^(ai-services/|student-[1-5]/|scripts/)

  - repo: https://github.com/Yelp/detect-secrets
    rev: v1.5.0
    hooks:
      - id: detect-secrets
        name: Detect committed secrets

  - repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: pip-audit-release2
        name: pip-audit Release 2 dependencies
        entry: python scripts/security/pip_audit_release2.py
        language: python
        additional_dependencies:
          - pip-audit==2.10.1
        always_run: true
        require_serial: true

name: Student 4 - Skill Profile CI

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - "student-4/**"
      - "ai-services/mcp-server/tools/student4.py"
      - "ai-services/rag-server/sources/student4.py"
      - "ai-services/agentic-loop/scenarios/student4.py"
      - ".github/workflows/student-4-ci.yml"
      - "ai-services/multi-agent-server/**"

  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "student-4/**"
      - "ai-services/mcp-server/tools/student4.py"
      - "ai-services/rag-server/sources/student4.py"
      - "ai-services/agentic-loop/scenarios/student4.py"
      - ".github/workflows/student-4-ci.yml"
      - "ai-services/multi-agent-server/**"

  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4


      # =========================
      # BUILD STUDENT 4 SERVICES
      # =========================

      - name: Build database image
        run: |
          docker build \
            -t student4-database \
            ./student-4/database


      - name: Build backend image
        run: |
          docker build \
            -t student4-backend \
            ./student-4/backend


      - name: Test Student 4 backend endpoints
        run: |
          docker run --rm student4-backend \
            python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

      - name: Build frontend image
        run: |
          docker build \
            -t student4-frontend \
            ./student-4/frontend


      # =========================
      # CREATE TEST NETWORK
      # =========================

      - name: Create Docker network
        run: |
          docker network create student4-network


      # =========================
      # START DATABASE
      # =========================

      - name: Start database service
        run: |
          docker run -d \
            --name student4-database \
            --network student4-network \
            -p 5004:5004 \
            student4-database


      - name: Check database health
        run: |
          for i in {1..10}; do
            if curl --fail http://localhost:5004/; then
              exit 0
            fi

            echo "Waiting for database..."
            sleep 2
          done

          exit 1


      # =========================
      # START BACKEND
      # =========================

      - name: Start backend service
        run: |
          docker run -d \
            --name student4-backend \
            --network student4-network \
            -p 5005:5005 \
            -e DATABASE_SERVICE_URL="http://student4-database:5004" \
            -e MCP_ENABLED="false" \
            -e RAG_ENABLED="false" \
            student4-backend


      - name: Check backend health
        run: |
          for i in {1..10}; do
            if curl --fail http://localhost:5005/; then
              exit 0
            fi

            echo "Waiting for backend..."
            sleep 2
          done

          exit 1


      # =========================
      # VALIDATE SEED DATA / API
      # =========================

      - name: Validate Skill Profile API
        run: |
          curl --fail \
            http://localhost:5005/api/profiles/student/4


      - name: Validate seeded profile
        run: |
          curl --fail \
            http://localhost:5005/api/profiles/student/10


      # =========================
      # START FRONTEND
      # =========================

      - name: Start frontend service
        run: |
          docker run -d \
            --name student4-frontend \
            --network student4-network \
            -p 5006:5006 \
            -e BACKEND_SERVICE_URL="http://student4-backend:5005" \
            student4-frontend


      - name: Check frontend
        run: |
          for i in {1..10}; do
            if curl --fail http://localhost:5006/; then
              exit 0
            fi

            echo "Waiting for frontend..."
            sleep 2
          done

          exit 1


      # =========================
      # DEBUGGING EVIDENCE
      # =========================

      - name: Show running containers
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker ps -a


      - name: Show database logs
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker logs student4-database || true


      - name: Show backend logs
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker logs student4-backend || true


      - name: Show frontend logs
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker logs student4-frontend || true
